newsitem.title: USA: Ispat Int'l files IPO shelf offering with U.S. SEC.
newsitem.headline: Ispat Int'l files IPO shelf offering with U.S. SEC.

text.p: Ispat International NV, Monday filed registration papers for an initial public offering with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
In a statement, Ispat said it expects to list class A shares on the New York and Amersterdam stock exchanges.

Ispat Intl is being organized to include certain of the steel making assets of Mr. Lakshmi Mittal. Those assets include Ispat Mexicana SA de CV, Caribbean Ispat Limited in Trinidad & Tobago, Sidbec-Dosco (Ispat) Inc in Canada, Ispat Hamburger Stahlewerk GmbH in Germany and Irish Ispat Limited in Ireland.
